correctness.rationale: For independent two-stage Coxian T=E_a+B E_b with a,b>0,0<=q<=1, the equilibrium age A has transform z(w)=(1-L_T(iw))/(iw E[T])=ab(b+aq+iw)/((b+aq)(a+iw)(b+iw)). In energy basis rho*_{jk}=rho0_{jk}z(omega_jk). The exact purity-minus-Hilbert–Schmidt-overlap term is sum |rho0_jk|²(|z|²-Re z); direct independent SymPy reduction yielded a² b q(b−a+aq) omega² /((b+aq)² (a²+omega²)(b²+omega²)), and the variance calculation gives identical prefactor (ab/2)(1−CV²). All kernel terms are >=0, strict exactly for nonzero-gap coherences equivalently [H,rho0]!=0. For q=0 and q=1−b/a when a>b the entire T Laplace transform simplifies to Exp(a)/Exp(b), respectively. Differentiating u/((a²+u)(b²+u)) yields unique u=ab maximizer unless zero prefactor. The reset mixed-state quantity is HS overlap, not Uhlmann fidelity. None of these steps depends on finite samples.
